tool.rowOffsets: 0,-15,...,-345 for 24 rows; aliases reuse directional rows
tool.special: resize at -360 and move at -375 exceed bitmap height 360; repeat wraps to existing cells. Preserve boxes; resolve artwork mapping explicitly in TASK-004.

checkboxRadio.disabled: same checked state cell plus field opacity
checkboxRadio.warning: radio bitmap width=51: do not derive cell size by dividing width into guessed columns; preserve unused pixels

sliderVertical.offsets: six diagonal state cells using measured x/y in component states, not a single horizontal strip

gridHeaderMenu.position: 0px center; do not resize image box to intrinsic bitmap

tree.arrowStateXOffsets: 0,-16,-32,-48 with center Y; folder/leaf are separate files; preserve indent/row height

dateMonthArrow.note: Classic overrides neutral datepicker/month-arrow hook. Do not invent a new datepicker/month-arrow replacement path.

tabClose.opacity: normal .6, disabled .3; source image is shared across state cells, no fabricated separate glyph file

loading.note: Animated GIF frames, durations and loop are recorded per asset; retain timing and display box when redesigning.

geometryPolicy: Byte-identical approved bitmap, exact density dimensions, unchanged CSS size/cell offsets. CSS adapters must be separately bound to approved hashes before integration; arbitrary CSS is denied.
